# Red Agave Landscaping

> Family-owned residential landscaping company in Phoenix, Arizona (legal name: RED AGAVE LANDSCAPING LLC), serving Valley homeowners since 2008. Red Agave designs, installs, and maintains desert-smart residential yards across the Phoenix metropolitan area. Every project starts with a free on-site estimate and a written proposal; the owner scopes each project in person.

## Contact and hours

- Phone: (623) 320-6940
- Email: red.agave.land@gmail.com
- Address: 1217 E Almeria Rd, Phoenix, AZ
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM
- Book a free on-site estimate: https://red-agavelandscaping.vercel.app/book.html

## Services

- Landscape Design and Installation
- Irrigation and Sprinklers
- Pavers and Hardscaping
- Desert and Xeriscape Conversions
- Artificial Turf
- Yard Cleanups and Haul-Away
- Tree and Palm Trimming
- Monthly Maintenance

## Service area

Phoenix, Ahwatukee, Chandler, Paradise Valley, Peoria, Glendale, Surprise, and Anthem, Arizona.

## Key facts

- Free on-site estimates: the visit and the written proposal cost nothing and carry no obligation. A typical estimate visit takes about 30 minutes.
- Founded 2008; family-owned and locally operated in the Phoenix metro.
- Desert-first approach: xeriscape conversions, drip irrigation, and planting matched to sun and soil so yards hold up in Arizona heat and use less water.
- Monthly maintenance plans keep installed yards trimmed, weed-free, and irrigated correctly.
- The owner scopes projects in person; the crew that starts a job finishes it, and debris is hauled away.
